headline: Public hearings on six new projects, including a fence at 137 Harvard Street and a railing at 116 Mulberry Street.
summary: Two continued hearings cover a sign at 211 Worthington Street and windows at 24 Beechwood Avenue. The agenda also lists a telecommunications facility at 10 Chestnut Street and a follow-up on a denied demolition delay waiver at 10 Prospect Terrace.
